title: Antigonus Gonatas
summary: Antigonus Gonatas is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Macedon, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 3754. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 3754 = 279 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.
